Requirement: Allow a customer to select multiple destinations for one trip, retain every selection, and display each destination correctly in the trip summary.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Selected Japan and Korea (South); /plans returned 11 results. Summary rendered “Koreasouth”, and reload retained only Korea.

Requirement: Provide clear default origin and destination values that can be changed without resetting the form.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Origin defaulted to Philippines and could be changed; destination started blank and required manual selection.

Requirement: Display the selected plan description, benefits, limits, and applicable conditions.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Malayan card, comparison, and /quote displayed benefits and limits; full conditions deferred to policy wording.

Requirement: Identify the principal traveller among multiple travellers.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Traveller 1 appeared first and the proposal PDF labelled that person Policyholder; form did not explicitly label principal.

Requirement: Accept a complete address of sufficient length and preserve it through policy and invoice generation.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Full supplied address survived application review, proposal PDF, and payment; official policy/invoice still need checking.

Requirement: Save every entered beneficiary and include the appropriate beneficiaries on the issued policy.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Traveller 2 beneficiary survived application review and /review; official insurer policy attachment still needs checking.

Requirement: Show progress and an actionable error if KYC submission or full-quote generation takes time or fails.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Submission showed “Generating quote…” and then /review; a KYC or quote failure response was not exercised.

Requirement: Send a payment receipt and the insurer policy document in separate customer emails.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Customer supplied the official Malayan eCOC image (COI 2026010594); separate receipt and policy emails still require inbox inspection.

Requirement: Make the official insurer certificate available for download when the insurer supplies it.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Customer supplied official Malayan eCOC image (COI 2026010594); issued portal still offered only its summary, not the official download.

Requirement: Include the final premium and complete trip route on the certificate or policy document.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Official eCOC image shows PHILIPPINES - JAPAN and Nov 2–9, 2026, but no final ₱816 premium is visible on the supplied page.

Requirement: Send the policy or COI to the correct customer recipient and not to a beneficiary by default.
Findings: 2026-10-21 staging UAT — Customer confirmed receipt of the official eCOC and supplied its image for lead traveller; recipient address and beneficiary delivery require inbox inspection.

Requirement: Make the travel journey usable on common mobile screen sizes.
Findings: At 390×844, the landing page and trip form use a single-column layout with no horizontal overflow. Traveler count popover and destination picker open and fit on screen; date, terms, and Find plans controls remain reachable. Issued-policy fallback also had no horizontal overflow. Results, quote, and payment screens were not tested at this width.
